issues.title: Remove exposed database credentials
issues.details: A root database password is hard-coded in src/mainpack/MyClass.java. Store credentials outside source code and rotate the exposed password.

issues.title: Make login and signup password fields secure
issues.details: Password fields use JTextField and are handled as Strings. Use JPasswordField and clear password arrays after use.

issues.title: Eliminate command injection and password exposure in batch files
issues.details: Signup and backup construct batch commands from user, database, and password text. Replace generated batch files with safer process execution and protected configuration.

issues.title: Make deletion of old bills and transactions safer
issues.details: Require a clear confirmation, backup check, preview of affected records, audit log, and a recoverable archive before deletion.

issues.title: Use BigDecimal for money values
issues.details: Billing calculations use double, which can cause rounding errors. Use BigDecimal for prices, tax, totals, balances, and applicable quantities.

issues.title: Standardize database transactions and error recovery
issues.details: Ensure every multi-step billing, inventory, and ledger operation is atomic, reports rollback outcomes clearly, and retains an audit record.

issues.title: Separate user interface, business rules, and database code
issues.details: Large screen classes contain SQL, accounting calculations, and UI actions together. Introduce services, repositories, and small data models.

issues.title: Avoid global mutable application state
issues.details: MyClass stores many windows and login state as public static fields. Use an application context and dependency injection instead.

issues.title: Improve database error handling and resource management
issues.details: Replace broad catch(Exception), printStackTrace, and generic dialogs with consistent logging, typed exceptions, clear user messages, and try-with-resources.

issues.title: Parameterize every SQL query
issues.details: Some SQL is built by joining values into query text. Use PreparedStatement consistently.

issues.title: Move slow work off the Swing user-interface thread
issues.details: Backup and signup wait for external processes and may freeze the application. Use SwingWorker or background tasks with progress and cancellation support.

issues.title: Add automated tests
issues.details: Add unit tests for totals, tax, inventory deductions, ledgers, and rollback behavior, plus integration tests using a temporary database.

issues.title: Adopt Maven or Gradle for dependency management
issues.details: The lib folder includes duplicate library versions and Javadoc jars. Use a build file with pinned dependencies and reproducible builds.

issues.title: Improve naming and cleanup
issues.details: Correct unclear and misspelled names, remove debug output, and centralize user-facing text for consistency and localization.

issues.title: Keep bill saving and transaction linking in one database transaction
issues.details: NewBill commits the bill, bill details, inventory, and customer balance before linkBillToTransactions updates matching transactions through a separate connection. If transaction linking fails, the saved bill and the customer's outstanding balance can disagree. Use one transaction for every part of bill submission.
notes: Completed on 2026-10-05: bill-to-transaction linking now runs on the bill-save connection before commit, so a linking failure rolls back the whole save.

issues.title: Prevent inventory from becoming negative at the database level
issues.details: New Bill and Generate Order Slip subtract stock without a database condition requiring enough remaining quantity. UI warnings are not sufficient when two users or windows sell the same item. Reject the save when any conditional inventory update affects zero rows, unless an explicit approved oversell policy is implemented.

issues.title: Do not terminate the application for an order-slip data error
issues.details: NewBill calls System.exit(-1) when an expected order-slip item cannot be found. This closes the production application and can interrupt active work. Show an error, roll back the current bill transaction, and keep the application running.

issues.title: Roll back and close draft order-slip transactions when the form is cancelled
issues.details: Generate Order Slip creates a draft row in an uncommitted transaction during initialization. Back and Reset dispose the form without rolling back and closing that transaction, which can leave database locks and abandoned draft work. Centralize cancellation in a method that rolls back, closes, and then exits the form.

issues.title: Make bill PDF storage production-safe
issues.details: Generated bill PDFs use a relative billsOut path and an unsanitized customer name. The final folder can vary with the application's working directory, and Windows-invalid filename characters can make saving fail. Configure one production folder and sanitize the customer-name portion of each filename.
